Primary (A) and secondary (B) metabolite biosynthesis pathways showing relative metabolite contents of wheat seedlings cultivated under different PPFD conditions

Primary (A) and secondary (B) metabolite biosynthesis pathways showing relative metabolite contents of wheat seedlings cultivated under different PPFD conditions. The metabolic pathway was adapted from the Triticum aestivum (bread wheat) KEGG pathway database. The colored squares (blue to red) indicate UV scaling values averaged for each metabolite. *P < 0.05 and #FDR < 0.05. KEGG, Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes; PCA, principal component analysis; PPFD, photosynthetic photon flux density

Comparative analysis of primary and secondary metabolites in wheat seedlings (Triticum aestivum L.) cultivated under varying photosynthetic photon flux densities and growth periods (2025) Ye Jin Kim, et al. J Sci Food Agric. 2025 Jun 13;105(13). Figure: F4.
